description: Run a live search for local businesses by niche + city (e.g. query 'electrician', location 'Austin, TX'). Returns a search_id and, usually, the first batch immediately (its listings are in `results`; their emails and phones are not verified yet — when discovery is 'in_progress' the provider was slow and the whole search was queued, so the leads arrive through get_search_results); more results are found and verified in the background — every email is SMTP-checked and phones are verified with line type + carrier. Spends 1 lead per result. Poll get_search_results until enrichment is 'complete'. If enrichment is already 'complete', nothing was found and nothing more is coming; if capped is true, the balance covered fewer leads than were found.

location.description: City, e.g. 'Austin, TX'. Not needed with location_code, which is always what is searched.

location_code.description: Optional exact location code. When given, it is what is searched, whatever location says. Sent with location, the search is named after the code's own place (or after location when the code's own name cannot be looked up); sent alone, the search is unnamed and location comes back null.

name: search_leads

capped.description: True when the lead balance covered fewer leads than were found — relay this to the user.

discovery.description: 'complete', or 'in_progress' when the search was queued whole.

enrichment.description: 'pending' until background verification finishes; 'complete' at once when nothing was found.

found.description: Listings found in the first batch, before the balance capped delivery.

leads_remaining.description: Leads spendable now. On a plan with no monthly quota this is what is left in the current 7-day period.

location.description: The place searched, as the location list names it (the location sent, when a code's own name could not be looked up); null for a location_code sent alone.

results.description: The first batch, as delivered — contacts are verified in the background (get_search_results).

phones_data.description: Verified phones with line type + carrier.

socials.description: Social profile links keyed by platform.

title: Search local-business leads
